inspected_public_main_paths.observation: MachineProfile and MachineCapabilities cover toolpath limits and session negotiation, not full process or product qualification.
MachineEntry.capabilities remains Vec<String>; MachineEntry.machine_type is a MachineType.
MRP run, planned order and material-shortage integrity records.
Work order integrity records bind product, quantity, due date, BOM/routing references and lifecycle status.

adapter_rules: No universal replacement manufacturing ontology, registry, scheduler, inventory or provenance store is created by this crosswalk.
MachineCapabilityCompiler case JSON is synthetic-only and is not a canonical owner-native schema.
Future adapters pin owner repository, schema id/version/digest, source revision, subject and receipt identity, raw disposition and revocation/correction state.
Adapters may weaken claims to Unknown/Unavailable but never upgrade claims to qualified or accepted.
Simulation, synthetic fixtures, vendor declarations, mapped sites and machine advertisements are never promoted to physical qualification.
A work-order completion is not an accepted part; a machine session is not a qualified process; a qualified individual unit is not production yield.

Mycelix MFG-PROC-001A typed references bind exact Symthaea contract crate/type/source commit and BLAKE3 object/process identities; until external owner objects are fetched and verified, the only local state is TypedReferencePresent, not qualified.

Mycelix MFG-PROC-001B resource offers separate published claims, declared capacity, calendar availability, bookable capacity, reserved capacity and observed output. A published offer never proves resource qualification or schedulability.

Mycelix MFG-PROC-001B v0.1 resource offers are provider declarations. They do not prove signer authority, owner-object resolution, resource/site existence, physical capability qualification, current calendar availability, bookable or reserved capacity, execution or accepted output.
claim_ceiling: Public owner/path audit only. Symthaea PR #5701 remains an open draft and its current-main replay #5901 is not qualified; Mycelix PR #6532 typed reference consumer passed its focused exact-head workflow but external process objects remain unresolved. Mycelix PR #6534 resource-offer schema/fixture tranche passed its exact-head push workflow but is stacked/draft and has no runtime, provider verification, resource qualification, calendar verification or booking. No private-workspace completeness, physical machine qualification, supplier approval, resource availability, production capacity, cost savings or local productive closure is established.
